name.baseName: Rare earth concentrate, 70% REO, from bastnasite, at beneficiation

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: In- and outputs are calculated from bastnasite ore composition mined in China. Infrastructure and land use approximated with iron ore mining. Some inputs of auxiliary materials are calculated according to stoechiometry. Rough estimation for energy consumption, wastes and emissions.; UUID: 1cf5cf73-cce7-31d0-b5ca-1fdb6dfe2fa3

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Mineral concentration by froth flotation to rare earth concentrate product with 70% rare earth oxide (REO). Leaching of concentrate with HCL included but no calcination.

# Included processes
The process includes material and energy input, emissions and land use for the mining and concentration of a bastnasite ore with a rare earth oxide concentration of 6%. Transport and infrastructure are estimated.
